deflectionLines: I just pour the drinks, friend. Try asking the scout.
Rumors? Hah! Ask someone else, I'm busy.
You want stories? Go to the dungeons, they'll give you plenty.
I'm keeping my eyes on the horizon, not gossip.
Ask the barkeeper, he hears everything.
Knowledge is the greatest treasure, but it requires patience.
The ancient archives hold secrets, yet many remain buried.
